_note: The base look. Every edit starts from this file with the creator's saved style (<workspace>/01_Styles/my-style/style.json, made by Build my style) merged over it. Change preferences there, not here.

captions._mode: chunk (max_words at a time) | word (one word) | bold (one big word; layouts) | small (one word under the chin; layouts) | off
captions._shadow: none | soft | strong | any CSS text-shadow
captions._box: null, or a colour drawn behind the words (e.g. "#000000b3")
captions._animation: cut (hard cut on and off) | pop (each chunk scales in over 0.1 s)
captions._keywords: words shown in keyword_color (a palette name or a hex colour); numbers too when numbers_are_keywords

palette._note: The graphics' colours. accent = the main colour (headline accents, underlines, bars, highlights); accent_light / accent_dark / key are worked out from accent when left out; ink = dark text; paper = light panels and cards; canvas = the light grid canvas.

fonts._note: hook = kinetic hook headlines, impact words, chips; headline = layout headlines, stats, banners; body = card text; serif = accents; mono = code and terminal text. Bundled: TikTok Sans, Inter, Hanken Grotesk. Or any font on the Mac (Baskerville, Futura, Avenir Next, Didot, Helvetica Neue, Menlo...).
fonts.headline: Hanken Grotesk

text._note: Looks for TXT.show (template/type.js): titles, labels, big numbers, text cards, code lines. Every key is optional; the full list is at the top of type.js. A style adds or changes presets here.
